source_and_access: [MOCS LL1 plans](https://www.nyc.gov/site/mocs/resources/m-wbe-ll1.page) publish planned solicitation attributes, while the Comptroller’s [M/WBE procurement reports](https://comptroller.nyc.gov/type/mwbe-procurement/) publish aggregate oversight findings. Neither is verified as a contract-keyed goal-percent feed.
join_feasibility: **Blocked.** No verified public source keyed by PIN or contract ID publishes the required goal percentage. The FY24 Comptroller report found approved subcontract records for only about 10% of eligible contracts; that is a measured reporting-coverage statistic, not a goal-field join rate.
reader_value: **5** — Money, prime-win outreach, and M/WBE subcontractors; shows the opportunity size and later goal attainment.
disposition: Keep as a publication request/monitor. Do not derive a percentage from aggregate reports.
